findings.one_line: The proof's split Δ=p+r_z+r_y omits 2a(r_z,r_y) from B^y=a(Δ,Δ)-a(P_yΔ,P_yΔ); equations (16)--(18) do not bound it, so the asserted outcome-gap envelope is not discharged as written.

The supplied attested Theorem 4 gives the stated N^{-1/(d+2)} log N bound after d_Y=1 and d_Z=d specialization; the node records the required source hypotheses.
The supplied attested Theorem 3.1 gives E|V_c-Vhat_c,n| <= C L_h n^{-s/(2s+d_Y+d_Z)}; d_Y=1, d_Z=d, s=tau, and block size N yield the node conclusion.
